_comment: Recipe ingredient lines that are not food: they are never bought as an ingredient, never block a diet tag and never make a recipe 'unklar'. rematch_unmatched.py resolves a stored unmatched line of this kind as ignored. Names are NORMALIZED like overrides.json keys (lowercase, umlauts asciified ae/oe/ue/ss, punctuation stripped). Nate, 2026-10-14. Add a name here when the report lists one; anything doubtful goes to the review TSV instead.

if_steps._comment: A name that can be the skewers OR a food. 'Schaschlikspiesse' is the skewers only when a cooking step puts food on them; otherwise (the prepared meat skewers, or no step to read) the line goes to the review TSV. The pattern is a case-insensitive regex over the steps.
